sources.title: Data sources
sources.noteNotFound: No logs found on this machine.
sources.noteNeedsSync: Logs found but not ingested yet — run a sync.

table.openSession: Open session — calls are grouped by pattern inside

pages.overviewHint: At-a-glance cost, token usage, and tool share.
pages.topicsHint: Group by topic, project, tool, or model. Click a topic to drill down.
pages.trendsHint: Daily token, cost, and tool/model distribution over time.
pages.sourcesHint: See which tool logs were detected and ingested.
pages.settingsHint: Configure language, classifier, and data collectors.
pages.activityHint: What your agents actually did — the concrete actions behind the token cost.
pages.roiHint: Unit economics: what one piece of work of each kind typically costs.

breakdown.sessionsHint: Each session is one stretch of work. Click to see call patterns, not a chat log.

session.title: Session
session.explainer: Each row groups model calls that looked the same to the collector. A single group may be dozens of billed API requests — typical when an agent loops (think → run a tool → think again). This is a cost breakdown, not a chat transcript.
session.classificationHint: The topic label used up to 8 snippets like these from this session.

pricing.title: Model pricing
pricing.subtitle: USD per 1,000,000 tokens. Cost = usage × these unit prices.

errors.backendDown: Can't reach the Agent-ROI backend. Start it with `agent-roi serve`, or open the app it serves at http://127.0.0.1:8000 instead of the dev server.

settings.thresholdHint: Higher = stricter (more, smaller topics). Lower = broader topics.
settings.labelTermsHint: Number of distinctive terms used to name each topic.
settings.budgetHint: Optional spend limits (USD). Leave blank for no limit.

budget.title: Budget
budget.noneSet: No budget set yet — add limits in Settings to track spend against a target.

composition.title: Where your tokens go
composition.hint: Most tokens are fixed overhead and re-sent context, not the conversation itself.
composition.overheadHint: System prompt, tool definitions and MCP schemas (cache writes).
composition.cachedHint: Context re-sent each turn, billed at the cheap cached rate.
composition.workHint: Uncached input plus output — the actual conversation.

activity.noMcp: No MCP servers were used in this period.
activity.noFiles: No files were read or edited in this period.
activity.empty: No activity recorded yet. Run a sync to collect it.
activity.tokenNote: Token figures are estimated from result size; tools whose results aren't logged (e.g. Copilot) show "—".

roi.flagHint: Highest spend rate — worth a look.
roi.methodHint: A topic is one kind of work; each session is one piece of it. Averages are per piece. Active time excludes idle gaps, with a threshold derived from your own usage. Consistency is the variation of per-piece cost (coefficient of variation).
roi.consistencyHint: How much cost swings between pieces of the same kind. "Erratic" can mean re-work or spinning wheels.
